plain.li: This place is yours now, {GOD}, and so are we who come to it.
{GOD}, {GODEPITHET}, take this place and keep it.
Let whoever stands here know it belongs to {GOD}.
[lowtech] I mark this stone for {GOD}, and the ground it stands on.
[tribal] Spirit of this place, make room: {GOD} lives here now.
[spacer] By the colony's word, this place is set apart for {GOD}.
[kind:archotech] We set this place apart for {GOD}, and ask nothing we have not earned.
[kind:hunger] It's yours, {GOD}, and I know you'll want more than this.
[priest] In the colony's name and mine, I give this place to {GOD}.
[god:dead] {GOD}, keep our dead near this place, and us when it's our turn.
[god:hearth] Let there always be a warm corner here for {GOD}.
[god:harvest] {GOD}, the first of every harvest comes here, I promise you.
I gave a place to {GOD} today. I said the words I knew, and some I made up, and I think they were heard.
We have a place for {GOD} now. I went back after supper just to stand there.
[priest] I dedicated a place to {GOD} on the colony's behalf. It's a heavy thing to speak for everyone.
[doubt] I set a place aside for {GOD}. Whether anyone lives there or not, it's ours to look after now.
[demand] You asked for this, {GOD}, and here it is.
[kind:hunger] There, {GOD}, now leave us be a while.
[offer:meal] Eat with us, {GOD}, as you always have.
[offer:meal] The best plate from the kitchen, {GOD}, because we ate well this week.
[offer:plant] The first and best of the fields, {GOD}.
[offer:plant] Some of the harvest for {GOD}, since the fields gave us plenty.
[offer:meat] Fresh meat for {GOD}, and the beast's thanks with it.
[offer:meat] Meat from the last hunt, {GOD}, so the next one goes as well.
[offer:fish] Fish for {GOD}, still cold from the water.
[offer:fish] A share of the catch for {GOD}, so the nets keep coming up full.
[offer:pelt] The finest hide of the season, {GOD}, from a clean kill.
[offer:pelt] A warm hide for {GOD}, for the cold nights ahead.
[offer:drink] A cup for {GOD}, and one for whoever is listening with you.
[offer:drink] Something to drink for {GOD}, poured from our own barrel.
[offer:drug] A little smoke for {GOD}, for the long nights.
[offer:drug] Something for the dreams, {GOD}, since that's where you speak to us.
[offer:medicine] For the sick you watch over, {GOD}.
[offer:medicine] Medicine for {GOD}, so the sick here get well again.
[offer:weapon] A blade for {GOD}, never yet drawn in anger.
[offer:weapon] A weapon for {GOD}, so ours can stay on the wall.
[offer:apparel] Something warm to wear, {GOD}, for whoever needs it most.
[offer:apparel] Good clothes for {GOD}, mended and clean.
[offer:art] Something made with care, {GOD}, for you to look at.
[offer:art] A carving from the stores, {GOD}, since it shouldn't sit in a crate.
[offer:silver] Silver for the road, {GOD}, wherever you walk it.
[offer:silver] Silver for {GOD}, because it does nobody any good in a chest.
[offer:metal] Good metal for {GOD}, the best we had in the stores.
[offer:metal] Metal for {GOD}, so our tools hold another year.
[offer:wood] Good dry wood for {GOD}, for a fire somewhere.
[offer:wood] Wood from the stack for {GOD}, since we have plenty to spare.
[offer:component] Parts that work, {GOD}, which is more than we can say for most things.
[offer:component] Parts for {GOD}, so the machines keep running.
[offer:textile] Cloth for {GOD}, for a bed or a coat or whatever is needed.
[offer:textile] Something soft for {GOD}, folded neat, since we had more than we needed.
[offer:craft] Something made by our own hands, {GOD}, and made well.
[offer:craft] A good piece of work for {GOD}, so you know we don't do things by halves.
[offer:other] It's not much, {GOD}, but it's the best we had to spare.
[offer:other] Take it, {GOD}, and remember who left it.
[godkey:hollin,offer:plant] Grown, not cut, {GOD}, as you like it.
[godkey:hollin,offer:medicine] Something for healing, {GOD}, since the green heals us first.
[godkey:hollin,offer:meal] A share of our table for {GOD}, grown in your ground.
[godkey:smoulder,offer:silver] Silver for the deep, {GOD}, and every word of it praise.
[godkey:smoulder,offer:art] Something fine for {GOD} to keep with the silver, down in the dark.
[godkey:smoulder,offer:metal] Good metal for {GOD}, given back to the rock it came from.
[godkey:bellwether,offer:plant] Sweet grass for the road, {GOD}, and go in peace.
[godkey:morel] Let it go back to you, {GOD}, the way everything does.
[godkey:morel,offer:meat] Meat for {GOD}, since all of it comes back to you in the end.
[godkey:morel,offer:wood] Old wood for {GOD}, to go soft and feed the mushrooms.
[godkey:ennu,offer:meal] A bowl for whoever comes to the door tonight, {GOD}, whatever face you wear.
[godkey:ennu,offer:textile] Cloth for the guest bed, {GOD}, whoever comes tonight.
[godkey:ennu,offer:drink] A cup for the traveller, {GOD}, in case you come thirsty.
[godkey:ennu,offer:apparel] A coat for whoever comes to the door cold, {GOD}.
[godkey:pip,offer:component] Parts that work, {GOD}, for whatever you're mending next.
[godkey:pip,offer:metal] Good steel for {GOD}, for the wires and the hum.
[godkey:pip,offer:craft] Something put together right, {GOD}, the way you like a thing to run.
[godkey:cirrus,offer:art] Something to look down on, {GOD}, if you ever look down.
[godkey:cirrus,offer:art] A carving set out where the sky can see it, {GOD}.
[godkey:cirrus,offer:textile] Light cloth for {GOD}, to lift on the wind if you want it.
[godkey:hush,offer:pelt] A thick pelt for {GOD}, against the lean months.
[godkey:hush,offer:apparel] Warm things for the lean months, {GOD}, and nothing wasted.
[godkey:hush,offer:medicine] Medicine for {GOD}, for the weak ones winter comes for first.
[godkey:undertow] Take it, {GOD}, and nothing more than this.
[godkey:selene,offer:silver] Silver for the moon, {GOD}, from a good day.
[godkey:selene,offer:drink] A cup poured out for {GOD}, to drink by her own light.
[godkey:selene,offer:art] Something bright for {GOD}, to shine back at her.
[godkey:mog] Nobody asked for this, {GOD}, so it's yours if you want it.
[godkey:mog,offer:fish] Fish for {GOD}, the best of the catch, as any cat would want.
[godkey:mog,offer:textile] Something soft for {GOD} to curl up on somewhere warm.
[godkey:murmur,offer:drink] A cup poured out for {GOD}, and a song with it, for the rain.
[godkey:murmur,offer:plant] Grain for {GOD}, so the rain comes for the rest of it.
[godkey:murmur,offer:fish] Fish for {GOD}, back to the water they came from.
[godkey:ducat] Here, {GOD}, it was never ours to keep.
[godkey:ducat,offer:silver] Silver for {GOD}, because coin should move, not sit.
[godkey:ducat,offer:art] Something fine for {GOD}, to pass on to someone else.
[mine,!scoffer,!doubt] Gone in the night, so {GOD} came for it, I'd bet.
[mine,!scoffer,!doubt] It's gone, {GOD} took it while we slept, I'm sure of it.
[mine,!scoffer,!doubt] Not a crumb of it left, so {GOD} was here in the night.
[theirs,!scoffer,!doubt] The offering's gone, and the others will say {GOD} came for it.
[theirs,!scoffer,!doubt] Gone by morning, so {GOD} took it, if you believe what they say.
[doubt,!scoffer] It's gone, and maybe {GOD} took it, or maybe it was the rats.
[priest,!scoffer] {GOD} took it in the night, as the old words say.
[scoffer] Gone, and if {GOD} took it, {GOD} has a fox's teeth.
[scoffer] They'll say {GOD} took it, but I'd look for a thief first.
{GOD}, hear me, just this once.
I don't ask you for much, {GOD}, so hear me now.
[pray:sickness] {GOD}, put your hand on them and break the fever.
[pray:sickness] Spare them, {GOD}, and take what you like from me instead.
[pray:sickness,inbed] {GOD}, I'm not ready, so give me a little longer.
[pray:sickness,god:healing] {GOD}, you mended worse than this, so mend them.
[pray:death] {GOD}, they're yours now, so be gentle with them.
[pray:death] Walk them the rest of the way, {GOD}, since we can't.
[pray:death,god:dead] {GOD}, light their way home and tell them we said goodbye.
[pray:raid] {GOD}, stand with us at the wall today.
[pray:raid] Keep them off us, {GOD}, and I'll owe you.
[pray:raid,god:war] {GOD}, give our arms your strength and our aim your eye.
[pray:drought] {GOD}, the fields are dust, so send us rain.
[pray:drought,god:storm] Open the sky, {GOD}, we've waited long enough.
[pray:drought,god:harvest] {GOD}, your fields are thirsty, and so are we.
[atshrine] I came to your place, {GOD}, so you'd know I meant it.
[kind:archotech] {GOD}, our case is set out plainly: judge it.
[kind:hunger] I know what you'll want for it, {GOD}, and I'm asking anyway.
[doubt] Whoever is listening, {GOD} or nobody, please.
[godkey:hollin] {GOD}, I planted three for every one we cut, so hear me.
[godkey:smoulder] {GOD}, name your price, and let us sleep easy.
[godkey:morel] {GOD}, be gentle, and be slow.
[godkey:ennu] Whoever you are tonight, {GOD}, there's a place by our fire.
[godkey:pip] {GOD}, if you're in the wires, keep the lights on for us.
[godkey:hush] {GOD}, we kept everything, wasted nothing, so pass us by.
[godkey:undertow] I know you always say yes, {GOD}, so say yes.
[godkey:helios] I know you don't listen, {GOD}, but thank you for the light.
[godkey:selene] {GOD}, I'll tell you everything tonight, so bring it back to us.
[godkey:murmur,pray:drought] Sing, {GOD}, please, the wells are low.
[godkey:ducat] {GOD}, I gave what I had, so turn our luck.
Thank you, {GOD}, I won't forget it.
[pray:sickness] They're on their feet again, and I know whom to thank: {GOD}.
[pray:raid] {GOD} stood at the wall with us today, I'm sure of it.
[pray:drought] Rain at last, and {GOD} sent it.
[scoffer] Fine, maybe {GOD} had something to do with it.
[doubt] Call it luck if you like, I'm thanking {GOD}.
[godkey:hollin] The roots held, and that was {GOD}, I'd swear to it.
[godkey:morel] Slow and soft, the way {GOD} does everything.
[godkey:selene] It came back in the night, just as they say {GOD} does it.
[godkey:murmur,pray:drought] That was {GOD}, croaking under the well before the rain.
[godkey:undertow] {GOD} said yes, and now I wonder what it'll want for it.
I prayed to {GOD} every night, and for what?
{GOD} turned away from me, and I don't know what I did.
[pray:sickness] I begged {GOD} for them, and {GOD} let them go.
[pray:drought] Not a drop, {GOD}, not one drop.
[pray:raid] Where were you at the wall, {GOD}?
[doubt] Nobody was listening, were they.
I prayed to {GOD} and nothing came. Either nobody is there, or {GOD} looked at me and turned away. I don't know which frightens me more.
I've said {GOD}'s name every night since I can remember. Tonight I couldn't.
[veiled] Some say {GOD} turns a face away to test the faithful. If this is a test, I'm failing it.
[near] {GOD} heard me. I know that much. {GOD} heard me and chose not to answer.
A fox took it in the night, {OTHER_nameDef}, not {GOD}.
You'd thank {GOD} for the sunrise, {OTHER_nameDef}.
If {GOD} is so busy helping us, ask for a new roof.
Coincidence, {OTHER_nameDef}, it's all coincidence.
[near] All right, I saw it, and I still won't kneel to {GOD}.
[god:harvest] It rained because it's the season, not because of {GOD}.
[god:healing] The medicine did that, {OTHER_nameDef}, not {GOD}.
Laugh all you like, {GOD} heard me.
Don't you dare speak of {GOD} like that.
One day you'll need {GOD} too, {OTHER_nameDef}.
I'll pray for you, {OTHER_nameDef}, since you won't.
That's {GOD}'s rain, {OTHER_nameDef}, and you know it.
Say thank you to {GOD}, {OTHER_nameDef}, it's only polite.
[mine] I asked {GOD} for it last night, so that's settled.
[theirs] Your god sent it, maybe, but {GOD} let it through.
Nonsense, {OTHER_nameDef}, that was {GOD} and everyone knows it.
We'll ask at supper whose god it was, and they'll all say {GOD}.
[theirs] {GOD} would have sent it sooner if you'd asked politely.
[mine] Fine, {OTHER_nameDef}, but {GOD} was here first.
{GOD}, hear my vow, and hold me to it.
[vow:nomeat] No meat until they're well, {GOD}, I swear it.
[vow:pilgrimage] I'll walk to you on my own feet, {GOD}, I swear it.
[vow:temple] You'll have a house worthy of you, {GOD}, I swear it.
[vow:beastspared] Not one of your beasts falls to us this season, {GOD}.
I kept my vow to {GOD}, every day of it. I didn't know I had it in me.
[vow:nomeat] They're well, and I never once touched meat. I'm having the biggest stew in the colony tonight.
[vow:beastspared] The season's over and not one of {GOD}'s beasts fell to us. I watched every hunt.
[vow:temple] {GOD} has a house now. I swore it, and it stands.
I broke my vow to {GOD}. I told myself it didn't matter, and I knew it did.
[vow:nomeat] I ate meat. I was hungry and I didn't think, and now I can't stop thinking.
[vow:beastspared] One of {GOD}'s beasts is dead at our hands. I swore it wouldn't be.
[veiled] Some say {GOD} turned away from me the moment I broke it. I felt the cold of it.
Don't wait supper for me, I'm walking to {GOD}.
I made {GOD} a promise, and today I keep it.
[lowtech] I'm going out to {GOD}'s place, and I'm going on foot.
Here I am, {GOD}, as I promised.
I walked the whole way, {GOD}, so listen a while.
[god:wild] Old tree, tell {GOD} I came.
[god:waters] {GOD}, I came to your water, and I'm not leaving dry.
[god:dead] {GOD}, I've come to sit with your dead an hour.
{GOD}, {GODEPITHET}, this day is yours.
We keep your day, {GOD}, as we kept it last year.
[about:harvest] {GOD}, the first sheaf, and the last, and everything between.
[about:night] On the longest night we keep a light for {GOD}.
[about:dead] {GOD}, tonight we say their names, every one.
[about:hearth] The fire's lit and the bread's broken, {GOD}, come and sit.
[about:storm] Thunder for {GOD}, and our thanks for the rain.
[about:hunt] A clean kill and a full table, {GOD}, we ask no more.
[about:wild] {GOD}, we leave the first green growing for you.
[about:waters] To {GOD}, for every river crossed and every catch shared.
[about:war] We stand for {GOD} today, every one of us.
[about:healing] For everyone who got up again this year, thank you, {GOD}.
[about:craft] Every good thing we made this year, we made under {GOD}'s eye.
[about:way] {GOD}, for every road walked and every guest who came down it.
[about:machine] {GOD}, the machines turned all year, keep them turning.
[about:void] {GOD}, we keep your day so that you keep your distance.
{GOD}, {GODEPITHET}, hear what the colony has decided.
We stand here for {GOD}, all of us together.
Say it with me: {GOD} keep us.
Whatever comes this year, we'll meet it with {GOD}.
[lowtech] Touch the stone, and say the name: {GOD}.
[doubt] It's for the colony as much as for {GOD}, and that's fine.
Go on then, {GOD} is waiting for you.
Off you go, and tell {GOD} we kept our side.
[dream:warning,danger:beast,clear] {GOD} stood between me and {SUBJECT}, and said only: not that one.
[dream:warning,danger:beast,veiled] I dreamt of {SUBJECT} with a light on its brow, and something behind it that watched me. I think it was {GOD}.
[dream:warning,danger:sickness,clear] {GOD} sat at {SUBJECT}'s bedside in my dream and would not look at me. Watch them closely.
[dream:warning,danger:sickness,veiled] I dreamt someone was counting breaths beside {SUBJECT}'s bed. They stopped counting before I woke.
[dream:warning,danger:anger,clear] I dreamt {GOD} stood far off, looking at the colony, and came no nearer however long I waited.
[dream:warning,danger:anger,veiled] The sky in my dream was the wrong colour, and everyone said it was {GOD}'s doing.
[dream:demand,clear] {GOD} came to me and asked for {NAME}, at {GOD}'s own place, within three days.
[dream:demand,veiled] I dreamt of {NAME} laid at the shrine, and a hand reaching for it. I think {GOD} wants it.
[dream:name] Someone I didn't know told me a name: {GOD}. I wrote it down before I could forget it.
[dream:name,clear] A god I had never heard of called {GOD} came to me and said its own name three times.
[dream:vision] {GOD} showed me the colony from above, small and lit, and smiled at it.
[dream:vision,clear] {GOD} spoke to me plainly, of the other gods and who is whose friend, and I remember every word.
[dream:vision,god:harvest] I walked {GOD}'s fields in my dream, and they went on for ever.
[dream:vision,god:night] {GOD} put the moon in my hands and asked me to keep it till morning.
[dream:vision,god:storm] I stood on a hill and {GOD} spoke to me in thunder, and I understood all of it.
[dream:vision,kind:hunger] Something with no face asked what I'd give for anything I wanted. I almost answered.
[dream:lost] {NAME} came back to me last night, well and laughing. {GOD} was with them, and they were not afraid.
[dream:lost,doubt] I dreamt of {NAME}, well and at peace. I'll believe it was {GOD}'s kindness.
Today is {NAME}. {A_nameDef} says {SUBJECT} keeps count of who keeps it, and who doesn't.
[years] {NAME} again. {A_nameDef} has been telling the young ones what {SUBJECT} did for the colony in its first years.
[tradition] {NAME}, as the colony always keeps it. {A_nameDef} found the shrine swept before anyone was up.
[about:harvest] {NAME} has come: bread from the new grain, and the first sheaf for {SUBJECT}.
[about:night] {NAME}: the longest night, and a lamp kept burning for {SUBJECT} until dawn.
[about:dead] {NAME}: a place laid at the table for each of the colony's dead, and {SUBJECT} asked to carry them our love.
[about:hearth] {NAME}: every door open, every fire fed, and a bowl set by for whoever {SUBJECT} sends.
[about:hunt] {NAME}: the season's best meat roasted whole, and the bones given back to {SUBJECT}.
[about:storm] {NAME}: the first storm of summer, and a cup poured out for {SUBJECT} in the rain.
[about:wild] {NAME}: green bread and flowers, and nothing cut today, for {SUBJECT}.
[about:waters] {NAME}: a catch shared and a coin thrown in the water for {SUBJECT}.
[about:war] {NAME}: the colony's weapons laid out and blessed in the name of {SUBJECT}.
[about:healing] {NAME}: everyone who got well this year sits at the head of the table, for {SUBJECT}.
[about:craft] {NAME}: the year's best work laid out for {SUBJECT} to see.
[about:way] {NAME}: a place at the table for a stranger, in case {SUBJECT} sends one.
[about:machine] {NAME}: every machine oiled and every light lit, for {SUBJECT}.
[about:void] {NAME}: the shutters closed and the lamps lit, so that {SUBJECT} passes us by.
{NAME} went by unkept. {A_nameDef} said {SUBJECT}'s words alone, and some say {SUBJECT} noticed who didn't.
No {NAME} this year. {A_nameDef} left a little something at the shrine anyway, and didn't tell anyone.

warm.li: {NAME} passed without a feast. {A_nameDef} says {SUBJECT} is forgiving, and next year will do.

blunt.li: No {NAME} this year. {A_nameDef} says {SUBJECT} won't forget it.

plain.li: We kept {NAME}. For an evening the whole colony was {SUBJECT}'s, and it felt right.
[first] Our first {NAME}. Nobody knew all the words, and {SUBJECT} didn't seem to mind.
[years] Another {NAME}. I remember the first one, and how few of us there were.
[tradition] {NAME}, as we always keep it. The children know the rite better than I do.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} the story of how {SUBJECT} came to be called {WHO}.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued happily over how {NAME} ought to be kept.
{A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} what {SUBJECT} is called where {B_pronoun} grew up.
